interface.title: MammaScope · Análisis de Concordancia IHQ – MammaTyper® (public demo)
interface.field: Breast cancer pathology / molecular diagnostics (IHC vs RT-qPCR biomarker concordance)
interface.stage_of_work: Post-assay data integration, quality control and reporting of clinical biomarker results
interface.what_it_is_for: Merging a hospital IHC Excel export (PatWin) with MammaTyper RT-qPCR PDF reports by biopsy ID, then classifying samples into molecular subtypes, flagging discordances, computing IHC vs RT-qPCR agreement statistics and exporting Excel/PDF reports.

data.note: I uploaded demo_patwin.xlsx (100 IHC records) and demo_mammatypper.pdf (100 RT-qPCR records) in Paso 1. The pipeline saved 98 matched samples to the demo SQLite database. Two samples were only in the PDF (26B97806, 26B99399) and two only in the Excel (26B97416, 26B97538). The demo session runs as a simulated admin with no login.

tree.general: Combine two lab reports on the same specimens, classify each specimen into a subtype, check where the two methods agree on markers and subtype, and report the results
tree.specific: Fuse the PatWin IHC Excel and the MammaTyper PDF by sample_id, derive subtipo_ihq_calculado and compare it with the MMT subtype in the batch alerts, review concordance and clinical alerts, and export reports and statistics
